description: Feishu eval suite manifest — read-only test case listing for manual selection, live evidence probes, and future batch evaluation. No live runtime controller.

test_cases.title: 发送消息到群聊
test_cases.instruction: 打开消息中的 bot 功能测试群聊，发送“Hello World”，并确认消息已发送

test_cases.title: 搜索消息并查看上下文
test_cases.instruction: 在消息中搜索“项目周报”，打开相关会话并停留在搜索结果上下文

test_cases.title: 新建空白文档
test_cases.instruction: 新建一个云文档，标题为“项目周报”，正文输入“2026年M2项目进展”

test_cases.title: 打开已有文档
test_cases.instruction: 打开云文档首页，找到“项目周报”文档并进入编辑页面

test_cases.title: 文档分享弹窗
test_cases.instruction: 打开云文档中的“项目周报”，点击分享并检查分享弹窗是否出现

test_cases.title: 创建日程
test_cases.instruction: 打开日历，创建明天下午 2 点的日程，标题为“项目同步”，并邀请张三

test_cases.title: 查看今日日程
test_cases.instruction: 打开日历主页，查看今天的日程安排并确认日历页面已打开

test_cases.title: 新建多维表格
test_cases.instruction: 新建一个多维表格，标题为“测试用例记录表”

test_cases.title: 打开最近的表格
test_cases.instruction: 打开多维表格主页，进入最近的表格并确认编辑器可用

test_cases.title: 发起视频会议
test_cases.instruction: 发起视频会议并验证进入会议中页面

test_cases.title: 加入视频会议
test_cases.instruction: 加入会议 ID 为 123456789 的视频会议并验证进入会议

test_cases.title: 会议中邀请
test_cases.instruction: 在当前视频会议中打开邀请面板并确认邀请入口可见

test_cases.title: 文档摘要发送到群聊
test_cases.instruction: 在云文档窗口打开“项目周报”，阅读标题和首段内容后，切换到飞书消息窗口，在 bot 功能测试群聊发送一条包含文档标题和摘要的消息，并确认消息已发送
evidence_focus: semantic trace should show Docs editor observed before IM composer
final report should show IM message send completion
screenshots should include both document and chat surfaces
test_cases.note: Cross-window final verifier only checks the IM completion; Docs observation must be reviewed through screenshots or semantic trace.

test_cases.title: 日程创建后群聊通知
test_cases.instruction: 在日历窗口创建一个标题为“跨窗口同步验证”的明日 10 点日程，保存后切换到飞书消息窗口，在 bot 功能测试群聊发送“已创建跨窗口同步验证日程”，并确认消息已发送
evidence_focus: semantic trace should show Calendar event modal or Calendar home before IM composer
actions log should show a product handoff without any scripted step chain
final report should show IM message send completion
test_cases.note: Calendar event persistence still needs human review from artifacts; final automated assertion focuses on the notification message.

test_cases.title: 多维表格信息记录到文档
test_cases.instruction: 在多维表格窗口打开最近的表格，读取当前表格名称或可见字段名称，然后切换到云文档窗口，新建或打开“跨窗口记录”文档，写入一行包含表格名称或字段名称的记录，并确认文档编辑器可用
evidence_focus: screenshots should include Base table surface and Docs editor surface
semantic trace should record a Base-to-Docs handoff
final report should show Docs editor/body verification
test_cases.note: Base source observation is reviewed through artifacts; final verifier focuses on Docs editor/body state.

test_cases.title: 会议中复制会议信息到群聊
test_cases.instruction: 在视频会议窗口确认当前处于会议中或邀请面板可见，读取可见会议标题或邀请信息，然后切换到飞书消息窗口，在 bot 功能测试群聊发送一条会议提醒消息，并确认消息已发送
evidence_focus: semantic trace should include VC meeting or invite surface before IM composer
screenshots should prove the cross-window handoff
final report should show IM message send completion
test_cases.note: This is a VLM cross-window perception probe; VC source evidence is reviewed from screenshots/semantic trace.

test_cases.title: 从文档内容创建日程
test_cases.instruction: 在云文档窗口打开“项目周报”，根据文档中可见的会议或计划信息，切换到日历窗口创建一个标题包含“项目周报”的日程，并确认日历创建日程弹窗或日历主页可见
evidence_focus: semantic trace should show Docs content observed before Calendar interaction
final state should be Calendar home or event modal
screenshots should include document and calendar surfaces
test_cases.note: Intermediate Docs content use is artifact-reviewed; current Calendar verifier checks surface readiness rather than full event persistence.
